name: helper-catalog-eligibility
goal: Only pure functions with two distinct runtime consumers appear under Helpers; private functions remain accessible from owners without a Helpers breadcrumb

evidence: Use purity plus two distinct runtime consumers for Helpers membership; retain private function detail/history access from owner without a Helpers breadcrumb.

Catalog tests already exclude single consumers, but classification and private detail navigation were untested. Extend existing category/entity tests and the helper grid revision/viewport matrix to cover owner links and breadcrumbs.
